title: ChartOptions
description: craggy-charts options. One flat object; every key is optional except type and data (or value for single-value types). Identical in every language.

data.description: Rows ([{...}]), plain numbers ([3, 5, 2]) or columns ({ a: [...], b: [...] }).

x.description: x / category / label column. Default: first text or date column, else the row index.

y.description: One value column or a list of them; each is a series. Default: every number column.

by.description: Split long (tidy) data into series by this column.

value.description: Value column (heatmap, calendar, treemap...) or the single value (gauge, progress, stat).

label.description: Label column, or the caption for gauge / progress / stat.

stack.description: Stack series: true, or 'percent' for 100% stacks.

horizontal.description: Bars, boxes and progress go sideways.

window.description: Live mode: keep the last N rows and scroll at constant speed.

inner.description: Donut hole as a fraction of the radius.

labels.description: Show value labels on bars, slices and cells.

gap.description: Gap between tiles as a fraction of the cell (default 3/16).

round.description: Tile corner radius as a fraction of the cell (default 3/16).

colors.description: Series colours: a list, or { seriesName: colour }.

series.description: Per-series overrides keyed by series name.

legend.description: Legend: true, false, 'top', 'bottom' or 'right'. Default: shown when there are 2+ series.

xAxis.description: x axis: { min, max, label, format, ticks }.

yAxis.description: y axis: { min, max, label, format, log, ticks }.

annotations.description: Reference lines and bands: { y, label } | { x, label } | { from, to, label, axis }.

layers.description: Combo charts: extra option objects drawn on the same axes, inheriting from the parent.

zoom.description: Wheel / pinch / drag zoom and pan: true, 'x' or 'xy'.

brush.description: Drag to select a range: true or 'x'. Emits 'select'.

group.description: Charts with the same group share crosshair, hover and zoom.

type.description: Draw this series as another type (creates a layer).

pattern.description: Tile texture for print and colour-vision deficiency.
